facts.fact: The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for South Africa: JINX, NAPAfrica and others in Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban.
The African IXP Association's undated list, retrieved 2026-11-09, places South Africa's exchange points in more than one city: Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban.
